title: "[New Skill] "
labels: new-skill

---

## Proposed Skill Name

Proposed category and kebab-case Skill name, for example `skills/backend/rate-limit-audit`.

## Problem This Skill Solves

Describe the recurring task or problem this Skill would address, and who benefits from it.

## Proposed Approach

A high-level outline of the workflow, tools, or scripts the Skill will document.

## Prerequisites and Access

List any tools, systems, or access this Skill will assume the reader has.

## Related Skills or Prior Art

Link any existing Skills, internal docs, or external references this would build on or replace.

## Are You Willing to Author This Skill?

Let us know if you plan to submit the pull request yourself or are looking for someone else to pick it up.
